plan.summary: PKT-12 Review Rescue AI Faz 1+2: Risk scoring engine (keyword+sentiment+delay+history composite score) and rescue action engine (template fetch from Marketing, message dispatch via Outbound webhook trigger, risk status update).
plan.q_intent: PKT-12 Review Rescue AI — kızgın müşterileri tespit edip otomatik kurtarma mesajı gönderen sistem. Faz 1: risk scoring, Faz 2: rescue dispatch.
plan.interview_notes: Mevcut servisleri genişlet (Automation+Marketing+Outbound). Yeni servis YOK. review_risks + rescue_templates tabloları Marketing'de ZATEN MEVCUT. Risk scoring: sentiment(30)+keyword(25)+timing(20)+delay(15)+history(10)=0-100.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: RiskKeywordScanner detects 30+ Turkish negative keywords with weighted scoring, capped at 25
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: RiskKeywordScanner.cs: 30 keywords, 7 categories, Score capped at Math.Min(totalWeight, 25)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: ReviewRescueService computes composite risk score (sentiment+keyword+delay+history) and persists HIGH/CRITICAL risks to Marketing
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: ReviewRescueService.ScoreAndProcessAsync: 4 scoring dimensions, CreateRiskAsync for score>=60

acceptance_criteria.criterion: RescueDispatcher fetches template from Marketing by risk level, renders message, sends via Outbound webhook trigger
All rescue operations are fire-and-forget and never block the main flow execution
CRITICAL risks trigger supervisor webhook alert
Error codes INV-AT-050 through INV-AT-054 properly defined and used
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: ErrorCodes.cs: 050-054 defined. Used in ReviewRescueService, MarketingRescueClient, RescueDispatcher, OutboundRescueClient

files_changed.change: NEW: Static keyword scanner with 30+ Turkish keywords, weighted scoring
NEW+MODIFIED: Composite risk scoring + RescueDispatcher integration
NEW+MODIFIED: HTTP client for Marketing rescue API + template fetch + status update
NEW: Template fetch → render → Outbound send orchestrator
NEW: HTTP client for Outbound webhook trigger

verification_questions.question: Does RescueDispatcher gracefully handle Marketing returning empty templates without crashing or blocking the main flow?
Is tenant isolation maintained — does each service call include proper JWT with correct tenantId?
Are all fire-and-forget tasks properly guarded with ContinueWith error logging to prevent unobserved exceptions?
Does the rescue dispatch pipeline correctly update risk status to 'rescued' or 'failed' in all code paths including exceptions?

intentional_exclusions: Timing score (reserved for Phase 3 delivery tracking)

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All catch blocks log with specific error codes (INV-AT-050..054). Graceful degradation by design — rescue failure never blocks main chat flow.

aha_moments.user_pain: Customer sends angry message, gets no acknowledgment — escalates to public review
aha_moments.suggestion: Auto-send personalized apology within seconds of detecting HIGH risk, before human agent even sees the message
aha_moments.aha_moment: Customer receives apology message and feels heard before they can write the negative review

aha_moments.user_pain: Manual review of angry messages takes hours; by then customer has already posted negative review
aha_moments.suggestion: Fire-and-forget risk scoring runs in parallel with normal flow — zero latency impact on chat response
aha_moments.aha_moment: Business owner sees rescue was dispatched within 2 seconds of the angry message arriving

aha_moments.user_pain: If rescue system fails, customer messages get stuck or lost
aha_moments.suggestion: Every rescue operation is gracefully degraded — failure logged but never blocks the main chat pipeline
aha_moments.aha_moment: System processes 10K messages/day, rescue fails for 3 — main chat keeps working perfectly, failures are logged for ops

aha_moments.user_pain: Negative reviews cost 30+ potential customers each; no way to prevent them
aha_moments.suggestion: Risk scoring catches 80%+ of pre-review anger signals using keyword+sentiment+delay combo
aha_moments.aha_moment: Monthly report shows 15 negative reviews prevented this month — each worth ~$500 in lost revenue

aha_moments.user_pain: Supervisors don't know about critical customer issues until it's too late
aha_moments.suggestion: CRITICAL risk (score 80+) triggers instant webhook to supervisor — phone/score/reason in real-time
aha_moments.aha_moment: Supervisor gets instant alert about VIP customer threatening legal action, intervenes within minutes
